title: Umar's Concern for the People
paragraphs: Umar ibn al-Khattab was a leader. At night, he checked how ordinary people were living. Sometimes he found problems that no one had told him about.
One night, he found a family with very little food. He carried supplies to them himself. He did not only send another person.
People around Umar were surprised. He had many duties, but he still cared about one family and their problem.
This story teaches leaders to notice people who need help. Good leadership is not only about giving orders from far away.
